reasons.correctness: FaqService#reorderCategory rejects missing, duplicate, foreign and null ids with error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch. It sets displayOrder i+1 and saves each FAQ. Unknown category throws ResourceNotFoundException. The PUT endpoint returns 204. Hidden tests 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: Endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. The body is FaqReorderDtoIn. Injection is through the explicit constructor. BusinessRuleTranslatableException key is added to messages_en and messages_pl. New MockitoExtension unit test runs with no Spring context.
reasons.design_fit: Validation and ordering logic sit in FaqService and reuse the repository finder and BaseService save. The controller only delegates. Minimal footprint, no new mechanism, names are clear.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceReorderUnitTest covers reorder, missing, duplicate, foreign id and unknown category. Only one test asserts the message key. A null list is untested. Global LENIENT strictness weakens stub checking.
reasons.graph_use: An initial graph query mapped the support/faq files, and the agent then read the service, controllers and entity before editing. Later navigation relied on grep and find for BaseService, exceptions and existing tests.
